in_sanskrit.name: Bharini
in_sanskrit.meaning: Belonging to Bharata or associated with Bharata
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Daughter or related to Bharata, a legendary king in Hindu mythology and the founder of the Mahabharata kingdom

in_hindi.name: भारिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: भरत के साथिया या उसे मिट्टी रखने वाली

in_marathi.name: Bharini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A woman who carries the mountain on her head or shoulders. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharati', meaning 'bringer of joy'. It is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who carried the mountain Kailash on her head.

in_bengali.name: Bharini

This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharati', meaning 'bringer of joy'. It is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who carried the mountain Kailash on her head.
